email.subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – pricing plans and thank-you redirect
email.body_text:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for your time on our calls. You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page and send customers to your own thank-you page after purchase. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- You added a yearly price, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show at checkout.
- You set the after-purchase redirect to your own thank-you page, and your test purchase took you straight to it.

What we covered:
- We mentioned that there is a tax setting for adding GST to your prices.

Your next steps:
1. Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer (you mentioned you would do this this week).

What we'll do next:
- We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

Here are the recordings of our two calls: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-1

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
